info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Enterprise Legal Compliance API
info.description: The Enterprise Legal Compliance API provides essential access to legal compliance information relevant to banking enterprises. This endpoint allows businesses to retrieve critical data related to various legal compliance requirements, ensuring adherence to industry regulations. Typical consumers of this API include compliance officers, legal teams, and audit professionals, who utilize the data for regulatory reporting and risk management. By streamlining access to compliance information, this API aids organizations in maintaining operational integrity and mitigating legal risks.

get.description: Fetches the details of a specific legal compliance resource by its ID, enabling users to view important compliance information and updates.
